report_name: Barracuda Warns of Critical Flaws Allowing Root Access in ESG

threat_actors.name: UNC4841
threat_actors.description: A sophisticated threat actor that previously targeted Barracuda ESG appliances for cyber-espionage by exploiting the CVE-2023-2868 zero-day vulnerability.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used by the threat actor UNC4841 in a 2023 campaign to exploit a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2023-2868) in Barracuda ESG appliances for espionage purposes.

malware.name: SeaSpy
malware.description: A persistent backdoor mentioned as being used by UNC4841 in previous attacks against ESG appliances for long-term espionage.

malware.name: Saltwater
malware.description: A persistent backdoor mentioned as being used by UNC4841 in previous attacks against ESG appliances for long-term espionage.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-116606
vulnerabilities.description: A critical authentication vulnerability in Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliances that allows a remote attacker to modify the appliance's global configuration without proper authorization.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-111560
vulnerabilities.description: An operating system command injection vulnerability in Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliances that can be triggered by an unauthenticated actor and chained with CVE-2026-116606 to achieve root-level command execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2023-2868
vulnerabilities.description: A zero-day vulnerability in Barracuda ESG appliances exploited by the threat actor UNC4841 in a 2023 campaign for cyber-espionage.

identities.name: Barracuda Networks
identities.description: The vendor of the Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliances, who issued the security advisory for the vulnerabilities.

indicators.name: Barracuda ESG Unauthorized Configuration Change
indicators.pattern:
title: Barracuda ESG Unauthorized Configuration Change
id: 2f8b1c9a-7d3e-4f6a-8b1c-9a7d3e4f6a8b
status: experimental
description: Detects unexpected or unauthorized global configuration changes in Barracuda ESG audit logs, which could indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-116606.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/barracuda-warns-of-critical-flaws-allowing-root-access-to-devices/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-04
tags:
  - cve.2026.116606
level: high
logsource:
  category: audit
detection:
  selection:
    Message|contains|all:
      - 'Barracuda'
      - 'ESG'
      - 'global configuration change'
      - 'unauthorized'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: This rule detects log entries indicating an unauthorized change to the global configuration of a Barracuda ESG appliance, a potential indicator of CVE-2026-116606 exploitation.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process on Barracuda ESG Appliance
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process on Barracuda ESG Appliance
id: 8c9a7d3e-4f6a-8b1c-9a7d-3e4f6a8b1c9a
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious shell or utility processes spawned by Barracuda ESG application services, which may indicate command injection via CVE-2026-111560.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/barracuda-warns-of-critical-flaws-allowing-root-access-to-devices/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-04
tags:
  - cve.2026.111560
  - attack.t1059
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '/usr/local/barracuda/'
      - '/etc/init.d/bnes'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: This rule detects the execution of common shell utilities as child processes of Barracuda ESG services, which is a strong indicator of command injection (CVE-2026-111560).
